title: REMAX Confluence Opens, Bringing Entrepreneurial Leadership and Growth-Focused Culture to Missoula
summary: Former REMAX agent and Montana real estate leader launches new brokerage under REMAX umbrella
body_markdown:
**MISSOULA, Mont.** – REMAX Confluence has joined the REMAX network, bringing a relationship-driven culture, experienced leadership and commitment to agent development to western Montana. The brokerage, led by Broker/Owner DJ Smith, marks a return to the brand where his real estate career began.


Smith launched his real estate career with REMAX in Missoula in 2014, spending several years as an agent before advancing into brokerage leadership roles. Over the past decade, he has served as a managing broker, grown market share for one of Montana’s largest brokerages and held leadership positions at both the local and state REALTOR® association levels, including serving as president of the Montana Association of REALTORS® in 2024.


“My journey started at REMAX, and the mentorship I received there shaped the way I approach this business today,” said Smith. “I’ve had the opportunity to work with other brands and learn from different models, but what always stood out to me was how REMAX supports entrepreneurs. When you’re building something of your own, it’s important to know the entire brand is invested in helping you succeed.”


##


DJ Smith and Karalie Smith, Broker/Owners of REMAX Confluence


REMAX Confluence joins a global network known for agent productivity, brand recognition and a franchise model designed to support broker/owners and agents. Smith said he was particularly attracted to the ability REMAX has to evolve alongside the real estate industry while continuing to provide tools, resources and support that help affiliates remain competitive.


“Real estate is always changing, but REMAX has consistently shown a willingness to adapt to the market and the needs of agents,” Smith said. “That ability to evolve, combined with the strength of the brand and network, gives me confidence that we’re in the right place to grow.”


The new office will initially launch with nine agents and plans to recruit additional professionals who align with its culture-first approach. Smith’s long-term vision includes expanding the brokerage’s footprint while creating opportunities for agents through mentorship, collaboration and professional growth.


“Everything starts with culture,” he said. “I’ve always believed that when people support each other’s success, everyone wins. That’s the kind of environment we’re building at REMAX Confluence.”


REMAX Confluence will serve homebuyers and sellers from its office at 690 SW Higgins Suite E in Missoula. For more information, visit www.remaxconfluencemt.com or call 406.926.1036.


###


**About REMAX Confluence:**


REMAX Confluence is a locally owned and operated full-service real estate brokerage located in Missoula, Montana and serving the communities of Missoula, Mineral, Ravalli, Lake and Sanders counties. The brokerage has nine real estate agents and specializes in residential, commercial, ranch, luxury and second home properties. Each REMAX office independently owned and operated.
